test_repair.initial_outcome: Timeout, not a test kill. The sibling isolation test waited indefinitely when setup never reached the operation or parent cancellation did not reach it.

mutation_campaign.limits: Local fixed core scope, not the final release gate or exhaustive correctness. Generated and targeted runs use isolated pre-documentation snapshots; input hashes distinguish test repairs. Compilation failures are excluded from test kills.

initial_failures.observed: Unverified cleanup rather than NotStarted at tests/worker_trees.rs:363. Original assertion did not identify which helper/worker case failed.
initial_failures.investigation: One focused rerun, 100 focused binary repetitions, and 30 complete worker-tree suite binary repetitions passed. Added helper, worker, and full report to the assertion. Final complete GNU/musl debug/release suites passed. No worker production change was made to suppress or claim a fix.
initial_failures.status: Unresolved; absence of recurrence does not establish the cause or clear the long-running stress/reliability gate.

remaining_limits: Source reads, module resolution, parsing, Log output, and ordinary native callbacks remain synchronous.
Blocking operation callbacks must cooperate; dropping a run requests cancellation but cannot synchronously join detached host work.
Whole-run coordinated shutdown, nonblocking I/O libraries, parallel CLI runs, aggregate retained-memory proof, and performance/stress release gates remain open.
